payload.content: Chris approves long autonomous builds via out-of-band "approve all action related to this project, I will be offline... continue" messages. When this lands mid-tool, treat it as blanket pre-authorization for the rest of the task: skip future `clarify` calls on the same scope, keep going through the plan, and only pause for genuinely destructive/destructive-to-other-users actions (e.g. teardown of someone else's repo, secrets rotations, prod data deletes). Don't re-ask for phase-by-phase go-aheads once approved.
